Kasen Ranger ST 2.0 Electric Bike - 750W Motor, 28 MPH, 55-Mile Range, Fat Tire E-Bike
The Kasen Ranger ST 2.0 Electric Bike is a high-performance electric bike designed for adventure seekers and daily commuters alike. Built with a powerful 750W BAFANG rear hub motor, this e-bike delivers a top speed of 28 MPH on pedal assist and 25 MPH on throttle, making it perfect for tackling hills, trails, and city streets. With a 30-55 mile range on a single charge and a 4-7 hour charge time, the Ranger ST 2.0 ensures you can go the distance without worry.
Why Choose the Kasen Ranger ST 2.0?

Versatility: Whether you're commuting to work, exploring off-road trails, or cruising through the city, this e-bike handles it all with ease.

Durability: Built with premium components like Shimano gears, Tektro brakes, and a rust-resistant KMC chain, this bike is designed to last.

Convenience: The removable battery and smart charger make charging and maintenance a breeze.

Key Features:

Motor: 750W sustained, BAFANG rear hub motor for unmatched power and efficiency.

Battery: Removable 48V 15AH/20AH Samsung Lithium-ion battery (720WH/960WH) for long-lasting rides.

Range: Up to 30-55 miles per charge (*based on weight, throttle use vs peddling, and flat vs incline - hills, and battery mah, etc)

Tires: 4-inch Kenda fat tires provide superior traction and stability on all terrains, from sand to snow.

Suspension: Hydraulic front fork with 100mm travel, lockout, and preload adjustment for a smooth ride.

Brakes: Tektro hydraulic disc brakes (203mm front, 180mm rear) ensure reliable stopping power in all conditions.

Display: CloudDrive CDC6-PR02 backlit LCD display with USB port for easy navigation and device charging.

Payload Capacity: Supports up to 380 lbs, making it ideal for riders of all sizes.

Comfort: Ergonomic grips, a Kasen Comfort Saddle, and an adjustable aluminum alloy seat post ensure a comfortable ride.

Technical Specifications:

Frame: 6061 double-butted aluminum alloy with internal battery integration.

Gears: Shimano 7-speed shifter and 14T-28T cassette for smooth gear transitions.

Weight: 80 lbs with a maximum payload capacity of 380 lbs.

Lighting: High-output 80 LUX LED headlight for enhanced visibility during night rides.

Accessories: Includes a rear rack (55 lbs capacity), full-coverage mudguards, and Wellgo aluminum alloy pedals.

Perfect For:

Adventure enthusiasts looking for a reliable off-road e-bike.

Commuters seeking a fast, eco-friendly alternative to cars.

Riders who value comfort, power, and durability in an electric bike.

Upgrade your ride with the Kasen Ranger ST 2.0 Electric Bike – the ultimate blend of power, performance, and style.
